title: Local surjectivity of the canonical higher-image sheaf-colimit comparison
statement: Let Λ be any commutative ring, k:W→S a morphism of schemes, G a sheaf of Λ-modules on the small etale site of W [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and q an integer. Let I be a small cofiltered category and D:I→Over W an inverse system with affine transition maps. Suppose every composite D(i)→W→S is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let c be a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting, and suppose c.pt→W→S is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Put H_i=R^q(D(i)→S)_*(D(i)^*G) and H_c=R^q(c.pt→S)_*(c.pt^*G), using [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Write t for the canonical transitions of [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions]. Let K:I^op→Sh(S_et,Λ) be a diagram with specified isomorphisms e_i:K(i)≅H_i, such that for every arrow f:j→i its map is e_i followed by t(D(f)) followed by e_j inverse. Let B be a cocone on K with a specified isomorphism e_B:B.pt≅H_c, whose leg at i is e_i followed by t(c_i) followed by e_B inverse. Then the canonical comparison colim K→B.pt (the unique map composing each colimit coprojection to the corresponding leg of B) is an epimorphism: any two morphisms out of B.pt agreeing after this comparison are equal. Equivalently its sections lift locally in the etale topology. No global section representative or uniqueness assertion is part of this statement.

proof.text: Given two maps a,b from B.pt agreeing after colimit.desc, precompose with each colimit coprojection to obtain equality after every leg B.ι_i. Transport a,b along eB.inv. The equation hB and cancellation of eK_i show that the transported maps agree after each canonical stage-to-limit higherDirectImageOverMap.

Apply the affine raw-class representative theorem. Equality after every stage map implies equality after the raw-to-higher-image comparison on affine etale objects. The dense-subsite restrictHomEquivHom of AffineEtale.Spec extends this equality of presheaf morphisms into an abelian sheaf to all objects.

The proved canonical module-valued presheaf comparison is locally surjective. For any limit higher-image section, its image sieve is covering. Restrict to this sieve, lift to raw classes, and use the equality from the preceding step. Separatedness of the target sheaf gives equality on the original section. Faithfulness of the forgetful sheaf functor and cancellation of eB give a=b, establishing Epi(colimit.desc K B).

theorem epi_higher_image_colimit_comparison
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℤ)
    {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] [IsCofiltered I] (D : I ⥤ Over W)
    [∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f).left]
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact ((D.obj i).hom ≫ k)]
    [∀ i, QuasiSeparated ((D.obj i).hom ≫ k)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget W).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact (c.pt.hom ≫ k)] [QuasiSeparated (c.pt.hom ≫ k)]
    (K : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (eK : ∀ i : I, K.obj (op i) ≅
      higherDirectImage Λ ((D.obj i).hom ≫ k) q
        ((((D.obj i).hom)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj G))
    (hK : ∀ {i j : I} (f : j ⟶ i), K.map f.op =
      (eK i).hom ≫ higherDirectImageOverMap Λ k G q (D.map f) ≫ (eK j).inv)
    (B : Cocone K)
    (eB : B.pt ≅ higherDirectImage Λ (c.pt.hom ≫ k) q
      (((c.pt.hom)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj G))
    (hB : ∀ i : I, B.ι.app (op i) = (eK i).hom ≫
      higherDirectImageOverMap Λ k G q (c.π.app i) ≫ eB.inv)
 :
    Epi (colimit.desc K B)
